auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Minerstat developer API key sent in the X-API-Key header. Create or view keys in the official Developer Portal: https://api.minerstat.com/dev/login

actions.name: list_coins
actions.description: List Minerstat coin profitability and market data, optionally filtered by ticker or mining algorithm.

list.description: Comma-separated coin tickers to return, for example BTC,BCH,BSV.

algo.description: Comma-separated mining algorithms to return, for example SHA-256,Scrypt.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for listing Minerstat coin data.

type.description: The Minerstat record type, such as coin or pool.

algorithm.description: The mining algorithm used by the coin.

anyOf.description: The network hashrate in hashes per second, or null when unavailable.

network_hashrate.description: The network hashrate in hashes per second, or null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: The current mining difficulty, or null when unavailable.

difficulty.description: The current mining difficulty, or null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: The estimated reward for one hash per second over one hour, or null when unavailable.

reward.description: The estimated reward for one hash per second over one hour, or null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: The reward currency unit, or null when unavailable.

reward_unit.description: The reward currency unit, or null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: The block reward amount, or null when unavailable.

reward_block.description: The block reward amount, or null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: The current price in US dollars, or null when unavailable.

price.description: The current price in US dollars, or null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: The last 24-hour trading volume in US dollars, or null when unavailable.

volume.description: The last 24-hour trading volume in US dollars, or null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: The Unix timestamp when Minerstat last updated the coin record.

updated.description: The Unix timestamp when Minerstat last updated the coin record.

items.description: One coin or multi-pool record returned by Minerstat.

actions.name: list_hardware
actions.description: List Minerstat GPU and ASIC benchmark data, optionally filtered by hardware type or brand.

brand.description: The hardware brand or manufacturer to return, for example nvidia or antminer.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for listing Minerstat hardware data.

url.description: The Minerstat URL slug for the hardware model.

type.description: The hardware category, such as gpu or asic.

anyOf.description: The estimated algorithm hashrate in hashes per second, or null when unavailable.

hashrate.description: The estimated algorithm hashrate in hashes per second, or null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: The estimated algorithm power consumption in watts, or null when unavailable.

power.description: The estimated algorithm power consumption in watts, or null when unavailable.

additionalProperties.description: One Minerstat benchmark for a mining algorithm.

algorithms.description: Benchmark data keyed by mining algorithm name.

specs.description: Provider-defined hardware specifications such as clocks, memory, release date, or power.

items.description: One mining hardware record returned by Minerstat.

hardware.description: Mining hardware records returned by Minerstat.

actions.name: list_pools
actions.description: List Minerstat mining pools and supported-coin terms, optionally filtered by coin or pool type.

coin.description: The supported coin symbol to return, for example BTC or ETH.

type.description: The pool category to return, for example multipool.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for listing Minerstat pool data.

url.description: The Minerstat URL slug for the pool.

anyOf.description: The founding year represented as an integer.
The founding year represented as a string.

founded.description: The year the pool was founded.

type.description: The pool category, such as pool or multipool.

anyOf.description: The mining algorithm used for the coin, or null when unavailable.

algorithm.description: The mining algorithm used for the coin, or null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: The payout threshold including any upstream unit.
The numeric payout threshold.
No payout threshold value.

payoutThreshold.description: The minimum payout threshold, or null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: The pool reward distribution method, or null when unavailable.

rewardMethod.description: The pool reward distribution method, or null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: The pool fee including any upstream percent sign or unit.
The numeric pool fee.
No pool fee value.

fee.description: The pool fee, or null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: Whether the pool supports anonymous mining for the coin.

anonymous.description: Whether the pool supports anonymous mining for the coin.

anyOf.description: Whether the pool requires registration for the coin.

registration.description: Whether the pool requires registration for the coin.

additionalProperties.description: Mining terms for one coin supported by a Minerstat pool.

coins.description: Pool terms keyed by supported coin symbol.

items.description: One mining pool record returned by Minerstat.

pools.description: Mining pool records returned by Minerstat.
